title: APEX System Card
description: One schema shared by the vague-to-system emitter and the APEX Stage 0 DECODE consumer. Both text styles (apex 'KEY : value' scaffold, v2s '## SYSTEM CARD' block) parse into this canonical object.

styles.apex: response scaffold: 'KEY : value' lines; required keys INTENT/MODE/RISK/ROOT TYPE, optional DRYRUN plus the v2s context fields
styles.v2s: '## SYSTEM CARD' header then 'KEY: value' lines; its own forge rules cover ACTOR/GOAL/DOMAIN/OUTPUT/CONSTRAINTS/SUCCESS/EXTRACTION_METHOD, and this schema adds the required MODE/RISK/DRYRUN/ROOT TYPE governance lines

intent.note: apex INTENT / v2s GOAL: one action and one outcome; max 15 words

actor.note: named person or role, never 'users' or 'we'

success.note: observable signal: 'I will know it worked when ___'
